issue.title: Ensure that JAX-RS Cookie parameter type is usable in Resource methods

body: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/28464 takes care of the issue. Seems weird that we never encountered a case of using `Cookie`  in a JAX-RS method...
Yeah, interesting, I suppose it shows manually dealing with cookies is done rarely
Well, cookies work, but they're usually deserialised to `String` ;)
